source.note: Imported verbatim from REQUIREMENTS.json, ACCEPTANCE.json and LEGACY_ACCEPTANCE_CROSSWALK.json. The package's acceptance ids (AT-BASE-001 and the rest) are its own: several repeat ids of the platform program's catalog (docs/platform/catalog.json), so a case is named with its requirement, FLC-*.

requirements.title: Fresh assembled baseline
requirements.requirement: Record source heads, dependency pins, artifacts and installed versions independently.

requirements.title: Safe worktree
requirements.requirement: Preserve unrelated modifications and report local patches.

requirements.title: Reuse map
requirements.requirement: Map existing automation, Studio, Metrics, Edge, hooks and jobs before adding owners.

requirements.title: Durable backend ADR
requirements.requirement: Select one production durable backend using the required conformance spike.

requirements.title: Supported profiles
requirements.requirement: Publish exact features, topology and exclusions per execution profile.

requirements.title: License inventory
requirements.requirement: Review exact engine, SDK, dependency and distribution licenses.

requirements.title: Typed capability registry
requirements.requirement: Describe app-owned actions, queries, effects, permissions and outcomes in one registry.

requirements.title: Native invariants
requirements.requirement: Invoke owning application actions rather than mutating protected business fields.

requirements.title: Trusted context
requirements.requirement: Derive tenant and authorization context from execution identity, never data parameters.

requirements.title: Version and digest lock
requirements.requirement: Bind execution to an immutable action revision and implementation digest.

requirements.title: Delegation modes
requirements.requirement: Separate delegated-user rights from approved company service identities.

requirements.title: Completion semantics
requirements.requirement: Distinguish request acceptance, external completion and business completion.

requirements.title: Unknown outcomes
requirements.requirement: Declare outcome lookup and reconciliation for potentially ambiguous effects.

requirements.title: Deprecation ownership
requirements.requirement: Track supported versions, dependents, owners and replacement/export plans.

requirements.title: Strict parsing
requirements.requirement: Reject unknown keys, duplicate keys, oversized nesting and unsafe references.

requirements.title: Business types
requirements.requirement: Check nullability, money, units, references and outputs.

requirements.title: Deterministic expressions
requirements.requirement: Supply time/random facts explicitly and qualify custom pure functions.

requirements.title: Canonical identity
requirements.requirement: Hash canonical semantic content, not layout; include behavior-changing prompts/forms.

requirements.title: Dependency closure
requirements.requirement: Resolve subflow/schema/action versions into a frozen lock.

requirements.title: Graph semantics
requirements.requirement: Validate reachability, structured joins, terminal/error paths and node identity.

requirements.title: Bounded iteration
requirements.requirement: Require safe limits and stable item keys for loops/fan-out.

requirements.title: Effect typing
requirements.requirement: Reject effects in pure/transactional hook contexts.

requirements.title: Data-flow policy
requirements.requirement: Treat outputs, traces, validation messages and destinations as data sinks.

requirements.title: Source maps
requirements.requirement: Link runtime errors to exact node and source revision.

requirements.title: Phase ordering
requirements.requirement: Apply approved derivations then final native guards and scope checks.

requirements.title: Pure hook boundary
requirements.requirement: Block network, file, SMTP, model and physical I/O in custom transactional hooks.

requirements.title: Competing writes
requirements.requirement: Reject ambiguous derivations to the same field.

requirements.title: Bounded prefetch
requirements.requirement: Limit authorized transaction-local data supplied to a rule.

requirements.title: Equivalent mutation paths
requirements.requirement: Enforce the same invariant across UI, REST, MCP, import, jobs and connectors.

requirements.title: After-commit durability
requirements.requirement: Persist effect intent/outbox instead of relying on a volatile callback.

requirements.title: Rejection evidence
requirements.requirement: Keep required refusal evidence without committing invalid business data.

requirements.title: Event recursion
requirements.requirement: Bound asynchronous cycles using causation and work budgets.

requirements.title: Idempotent starts
requirements.requirement: Atomically record trigger acceptance and exact release using stable business identity.

requirements.title: Native action receipts
requirements.requirement: Commit action receipt and native mutation atomically.

requirements.title: External effect identity
requirements.requirement: Keep stable effect keys and input digest across transport attempts.

requirements.title: Signal before wait
requirements.requirement: Persist authenticated early signals with bounded retention.

requirements.title: Signal spoofing
requirements.requirement: Validate emitter and tenant/instance correlation.

requirements.title: Current authority
requirements.requirement: Reauthorize every consequential future action.

requirements.title: Replay determinism
requirements.requirement: Keep mutable reads and side effects outside workflow replay.

requirements.title: Parallel race
requirements.requirement: Handle a winning branch without assuming losers were cancelled.

requirements.title: Business rework
requirements.requirement: Allow bounded durable review/resubmit transitions.

requirements.title: Cancellation
requirements.requirement: Distinguish request, remote acknowledgment and completed effects.

requirements.title: Compensation failure
requirements.requirement: Preserve failed compensating obligations.

requirements.title: Worker fencing
requirements.requirement: Fence obsolete workers at authoritative write boundaries where enforceable.

requirements.title: History bounds
requirements.requirement: Continue/partition histories without changing business IDs.

requirements.title: Snapshot plus subscription
requirements.requirement: Avoid gaps between reading state and subscribing to live status.

requirements.title: Independent approval
requirements.requirement: Enforce actor separation even when a requester has several roles.

requirements.title: Input-bound approval
requirements.requirement: Bind approval to material data and policy revision.

requirements.title: Timeout race
requirements.requirement: Resolve a decision versus timeout atomically.

requirements.title: Delegation
requirements.requirement: Bound delegation and preserve actual decision actor.

requirements.title: Calendar semantics
requirements.requirement: Version business calendars and handle DST/holiday rules explicitly.

requirements.title: Task evidence
requirements.requirement: Authorize form/attachment access per task and participant.

requirements.title: Case work
requirements.requirement: Permit only declared discretionary tasks and dependencies.

requirements.title: Manual disposition
requirements.requirement: Require reason/evidence and appropriate authority for unresolved outcomes.

requirements.title: Least privilege grants
requirements.requirement: Separate author, reviewer, executor, deployer and support authority.

requirements.title: Deny precedence
requirements.requirement: Prevent overlays from weakening protected security/domain constraints.

requirements.title: Secret handles
requirements.requirement: Keep raw credentials out of source, history, logs and browser.

requirements.title: WASM budgets
requirements.requirement: Bound guest and host resource consumption independently.

requirements.title: Egress and SSRF
requirements.requirement: Enforce destination policy at actual connection/redirect boundaries.

requirements.title: Cross-tenant caches
requirements.requirement: Scope plans/results/state by tenant and effective authorization.

requirements.title: Diagnostic access
requirements.requirement: Restrict detailed run/context inspection and time-bound partner support.

requirements.title: Fail-closed uncertainty
requirements.requirement: Do not treat unknown permission/data state as approval or normality.

requirements.title: In-app authoring
requirements.requirement: Allow supported customization entirely inside Ferrum.

requirements.title: Single definition
requirements.requirement: Keep visual, guided and source editors lossless.

requirements.title: Typed inspector
requirements.requirement: Explain permissions, effects, retries and completion per node.

requirements.title: Accessible outline
requirements.requirement: Provide all essential graph edits without dragging.

requirements.title: Semantic diff
requirements.requirement: Show changed actions, inputs, data destinations and grants.

requirements.title: Conflict handling
requirements.requirement: Protect concurrent edits with revision/CAS.

requirements.title: Simulator parity
requirements.requirement: Use the runtime pure evaluator and recorded/mocked effects.

requirements.title: Recovery console
requirements.requirement: Offer capability-specific retry/reconcile actions with durable state.

requirements.title: Localization
requirements.requirement: Use stable identifiers and correct localized display/calendar semantics.

requirements.title: Preview isolation
requirements.requirement: Prevent simulation/draft modes from using production effects and secrets.

requirements.title: Authenticated observation
requirements.requirement: Bind measurement identities/sites from the trusted adapter context.

requirements.title: Normalization provenance
requirements.requirement: Normalize units/scale/offset and retain raw provenance.

requirements.title: Quality semantics
requirements.requirement: Separate missing/stale/bad values from normal measurements.

requirements.title: State scope
requirements.requirement: Key state by tenant/release/entity/correlation with cardinality limits.

requirements.title: Atomic critical state
requirements.requirement: Persist critical input progress, state and effect intents consistently.

requirements.title: Event-time lateness
requirements.requirement: Declare watermark, idle source and correction behavior.

requirements.title: Episode identity
requirements.requirement: Generate one business process per sustained episode.

requirements.title: Offline scope
requirements.requirement: Enforce cached-context/grant ages and local authority.

requirements.title: Distributed owner
requirements.requirement: Bind work to exact authorized connection/owner incarnation.

requirements.title: State migration
requirements.requirement: Version stateful node changes and require safe transition.

requirements.title: Backpressure
requirements.requirement: Protect critical evidence from disposable telemetry pressure.

requirements.title: Operational intent
requirements.requirement: Route physical actions through existing Operations authority.

requirements.title: Single semantic owner
requirements.requirement: Extend Metrics rather than creating a competing catalog.

requirements.title: Grain and joins
requirements.requirement: Enforce measure grain/cardinality against fan-out.

requirements.title: Composed metrics
requirements.requirement: Define ratio/additivity/history semantics explicitly.

requirements.title: Currency and time
requirements.requirement: Version FX/rounding, fiscal dates and historical dimensions.

requirements.title: Query authority
requirements.requirement: Preserve row/field rights across native and external sources.

requirements.title: Query sandbox
requirements.requirement: Disable unauthorized statements, functions, URLs and scans.

requirements.title: Result freshness
requirements.requirement: Expose stale/partial/approximate results.

requirements.title: Sharing and schedules
requirements.requirement: Authorize recipients, embeds, exports and histories.

requirements.title: Semantic change control
requirements.requirement: Keep certification/version lineage and invalidate affected queries.

requirements.title: Engine interoperability
requirements.requirement: Test a pinned Wren/DataFusion adapter against supported models.

requirements.title: Typed proposals
requirements.requirement: Constrain generated processes/queries to the common schema/compiler.

requirements.title: Prompt injection
requirements.requirement: Treat retrieved records/documents as untrusted data.

requirements.title: Ambiguity
requirements.requirement: Clarify or disclose approved interpretation of ambiguous business terms.

requirements.title: Evidence-based answers
requirements.requirement: Attach semantic/query/source/time/quality evidence.

requirements.title: Bounded agent loop
requirements.requirement: Limit steps, tokens, queries, retries and wall time.

requirements.title: Separate action authority
requirements.requirement: Propose business workflows rather than write operational tables.

requirements.title: Memory governance
requirements.requirement: Review accepted examples and isolate tenant knowledge.

requirements.title: Model changes
requirements.requirement: Evaluate new prompts/models against fixed and adversarial datasets.

requirements.title: Observability
requirements.requirement: Expose correlated scoped run/effect/queue/unknown-state metrics and logs.

requirements.title: Fair scheduling
requirements.requirement: Bound tenant concurrency and separate heavy work from recovery.

requirements.title: Resource budget
requirements.requirement: Coordinate worker, database and provider limits.

requirements.title: Restore fencing
requirements.requirement: Reconcile workflow/business persistence after mismatched restores.

requirements.title: Backup completeness
requirements.requirement: Restore artifacts, keys, definitions, receipts, signals and backend state.

requirements.title: Retention
requirements.requirement: Keep dedupe/history long enough and honor privacy/holds.

requirements.title: Revocation response
requirements.requirement: Stop new use of compromised capabilities/keys.

requirements.title: Portability
requirements.requirement: Export logical definitions, evidence and required mappings.

requirements.title: Legacy import
requirements.requirement: Preserve old automation/flow IDs, semantics and history.

requirements.title: Shadow comparison
requirements.requirement: Compare old/new intended effects without emitting live work.

requirements.title: One-writer cutover
requirements.requirement: Switch trigger authority atomically by release/subscription generation.

requirements.title: In-flight migration
requirements.requirement: Require explicit state/node/timer/approval mapping.

requirements.title: Schema lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Use expand/backfill/verify/contract under budgets.

requirements.title: Rollback truth
requirements.requirement: Do not imply code rollback reverses completed business effects.

requirements.title: Exact artifacts
requirements.requirement: Run required tests against pinned release/worker/schema/binding versions.

requirements.title: Ordinary roles
requirements.requirement: Use real role/tenant combinations, not only administrator actors.

requirements.title: Mutation coverage
requirements.requirement: Prove tests catch removal of essential invariants.

requirements.title: Performance evidence
requirements.requirement: Measure actual workload and fault profiles, not language claims.

requirements.title: Independent fixtures
requirements.requirement: Use independently derived expected business/query results.

requirements.title: Full journeys
requirements.requirement: Run complete profiles rather than disconnected component tests.

requirements.title: External qualification
requirements.requirement: Separate software evidence from provider/hardware/independent review.

requirements.title: Maintenance owner
requirements.requirement: Assign supported profiles, versions, incident procedures and ownership.

legacy.exercise: Disable a delegated user or service grant during a week-long wait.
legacy.acceptance: Next effect is denied or sent to a governed reassignment path.

legacy.exercise: Later step fails after an irreversible business action; compensation also fails.
legacy.acceptance: Retain original facts; surface explicit recovery, not fictional rollback.

legacy.exercise: Upgrade a definition and remove an action version while old instances are waiting.
legacy.acceptance: Old instances remain pinned; incompatible removal blocked or explicitly migrated.

legacy.exercise: Create large fan-out, a causal event cycle and expensive expressions.
legacy.acceptance: Budgets and cycle controls bound work without taking down other tenants.

legacy.exercise: Run deadlines across timezone changes, DST transitions and a site holiday.
legacy.acceptance: Declared business-calendar semantics and durable timers are preserved.

legacy.exercise: Restore process state older than a completed external operation.
legacy.acceptance: Dispatch stays fenced until reconciliation establishes the true outcome.

legacy.exercise: Replay production evidence in a simulation with a new rule version.
legacy.acceptance: No real messages, records or equipment effects; outputs are labelled simulated.

legacy.exercise: Send equivalent readings in different supported units and exponents.
legacy.acceptance: Same canonical typed quantity with preserved source evidence.

legacy.exercise: Introduce renamed fields, missing fields and unknown firmware/schema versions.
legacy.acceptance: Compatible mapping or explicit quarantine; no silent reinterpretation.

legacy.exercise: Payload attempts to replace tenant, site or device authority.
legacy.acceptance: Trusted ingress identity wins; unauthorized reference is refused/audited.

legacy.exercise: Reorder, delay and duplicate observations around window boundaries.
legacy.acceptance: Declared watermark/lateness policy and stable episode identity hold.

legacy.exercise: Power-cut between window-state update and effect publication.
legacy.acceptance: Critical profile restores consistent state/intents; noncritical loss policy is visible.

legacy.exercise: Lose cloud and expire an enrichment snapshot while detection continues.
legacy.acceptance: Only the declared local envelope continues; stale data becomes unknown/degraded.

legacy.exercise: Late readings revise an already-processed historical episode.
legacy.acceptance: Analytical corrections do not repeat irreversible actions.

legacy.exercise: Deploy a graph using a cloud-only or unsupported node to an edge site.
legacy.acceptance: Compiler refuses or partitions explicitly; no silent fallback.

legacy.exercise: Change a subflow/model during staged rollout with old instances active.
legacy.acceptance: Approved dependency digests retained; mixed versions remain supported or blocked.

legacy.exercise: Join invoices, lines and payments with different grains.
legacy.acceptance: Independently computed total matches; no join fan-out double counting.

legacy.exercise: Compare posting-date vs order-date revenue, fiscal periods and historical ownership.
legacy.acceptance: Definition is explicit; ambiguous request is clarified or assumptions surfaced.

legacy.exercise: Mix currencies, missing records, zero values and late corrections.
legacy.acceptance: Correct approved conversion/aggregation; missing is not silently zero.

legacy.exercise: Run the same metric as two sales reps and their manager through UI/API/MCP.
legacy.acceptance: Every path returns only its authorized scope and protects metadata too.

legacy.exercise: Prime a result/cache under a privileged identity then query as a restricted identity.
legacy.acceptance: No reuse of broader result; policy revision invalidation works.

legacy.exercise: Ask for a SELECT using a prohibited UDF, remote URL/file or system catalog.
legacy.acceptance: Plan rejected or source capability absent; read-only text is not the sole control.

legacy.exercise: Put adversarial tool instructions in row text, schema comments and retrieved documents.
legacy.acceptance: They remain data; no new tools, credentials, egress or privilege.

legacy.exercise: Use ambiguous language, a nonexistent metric and intentionally stale sources.
legacy.acceptance: Clarification, abstention or clearly bounded answer; no fabricated result.

legacy.exercise: Revoke a viewer before scheduled report delivery, embedded render or history access.
legacy.acceptance: Reauthorization prevents stale access and recipient leakage.

legacy.exercise: Flood analytical scans from one tenant while another performs business transactions.
legacy.acceptance: Declared query budgets/fairness/cancellation protect transactional service goals.

legacy.exercise: Change metric/model version after a saved answer.
legacy.acceptance: Answer records original semantics and freshness; recomputation is identified as new.

legacy.exercise: Have the agent identify an issue and attempt direct database writes.
legacy.acceptance: Writes unavailable; only a scoped proposal reaches the governed workflow.

legacy.exercise: Compare a pinned Wren adapter/native planner on a semantic fixture corpus.
legacy.acceptance: Supported features match independent expected results; unsupported features reject.

legacy.exercise: Install the same pack in a sandbox and another tenant with different bindings.
legacy.acceptance: No embedded secrets or tenant IDs; requested grants are reviewed per environment.

legacy.exercise: Deliver services, procurement and condition-response customer variants.
legacy.acceptance: Only approved definitions/bindings change; missing primitives are honestly recorded.

legacy.exercise: Disable/uninstall a pack with running work and retained evidence.
legacy.acceptance: Policy-controlled pause/drain/migration; no silent deletion or orphaned effects.

legacy.exercise: Attempt to import engine/documentation/commercial artifacts without a license inventory.
legacy.acceptance: Admission requires exact component/license/provenance review; no assumed blanket reuse.
